prompt: Use case: illustration-story. A single landscape 3:2 illustration for the historical atlas sketchbook of Jules Verne's Twenty Thousand Leagues Under the Sea. A nineteenth-century naturalist's field sketch in graphite and sepia pen with restrained transparent watercolour washes on warm ivory paper. Fine irregular parallel hatching, economical contour lines, a few details sharply observed; leave areas of cream paper around irregular unfinished edges. One coherent scene that reads at small sizes. No captions, labels, border, binding, signatures, photorealism, modern equipment, or Disney submarine designs. Close underwater still life of scattered old Spanish silver coins and an open decayed wooden chest amid the ribs of a sunken galleon in Vigo Bay. A single gloved hand of a diver gathers coins into a plain sack in the light of an electric lamp. Barnacles and silt, no lettering.
